clues.it: Ugo era nella 9ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Giada.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 9th column, in the 1st row and in a different room from Giada.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un bancone e in una stanza diversa da Luca.

clues.it: Luca era nella 3ª riga e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Luca was in the 3rd row and north of Carla.

clues.it: Marta era nella 4ª riga, accanto a una sella e nelle Stalle.
clues.en: Marta was in the 4th row, beside a saddle and in the Stables.

clues.it: Giada era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a uno sgabello da saloon e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Giada was in the 5th column, beside a saloon stool and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Anna era a nord di Paolo e nelle Stalle.
clues.en: Anna was north of Paolo and in the Stables.

clues.en: Vito was the only one sitting on a chair and west of Giada.

clues.it: Paolo era accanto a un cavallo e in una stanza diversa da Vito.
clues.en: Paolo was beside a horse and in a different room from Vito.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era nella stessa stanza di Carla, ma non era accanto a un carro.
clues.en: Olga was in the same room as Carla, but was not beside a wagon.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 1st row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 2nd, column 7th.

steps.en: The general clue “1 person in the Bank” cannot add up without Luca: they must be at row 3rd, column 10th.
